name: Baur au Lac
insider_take: Where old-world Swiss elegance meets Lake Zurich's pristine shores—this is luxury hospitality perfected over 175 years.
whats_special: The Baur au Lac sits on its own private park between Lake Zurich and the Schanzengraben canal, making it the only hotel in the city with direct lake access. Since 1844, it's been family-owned by the Kracht family and has hosted everyone from Richard Wagner to modern-day royalty. The hotel's Paradeplatz location puts you steps from Bahnhofstrasse, one of the world's most exclusive shopping streets.
pro_tip: Book a lake-view room on the upper floors for stunning vistas of the Swiss Alps reflected in Lake Zurich—the sunrise views are absolutely magical and worth the upgrade.
dont_miss: Take afternoon tea in the winter garden while watching swans glide across the lake, and visit the hotel's wine cellar housing over 30,000 bottles. The nearby Zurich Opera House is just a 5-minute walk, and you can catch a vintage steamboat directly from the hotel's lakefront for scenic cruises around Lake Zurich.
pros: Prime location overlooking Lake Zurich and the Alps
Historic luxury property with 175+ years of heritage
Exceptional fine dining with Michelin-starred restaurant
Impeccable service and attention to detail
cons: Traditional formal atmosphere may not suit all preferences
